in_marathi.name: Hrithvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrithvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hrithvansh is derived from Sanskrit roots 'hrith' (God) and 'vansh' (lineage). It represents the divine descent or the divine lineage of an individual. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with gods and their dynasties.
